# ankra_playground (Resource)

An Ankra playground: a ready-to-use Kubernetes environment on Ankra's shared hosts. The counterpart of `ankra cluster playground create`, `resize` and `destroy`. `data.ankra_playground_plans` lists the sizes. A paid playground resizes in place to another paid plan; the free trial cannot be resized, so moving to or from `trial` replaces the playground.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_playground_plans" "all" {}

resource "ankra_playground" "example" {
  # "trial" is the free plan; a paid plan resizes in place to another paid plan.
  plan = "starter"
}

output "playground_phase" {
  value = ankra_playground.example.phase
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_trial_downgrade` (Boolean) Allow a change from a paid plan to `trial`. The platform cannot resize to the trial, so the change destroys the paid playground and everything on it and orders a new trial. Without this, such a change is refused at plan time. Defaults to `false`.
- `plan` (String) Plan id of the size to order. Defaults to `trial`, the free plan, which the platform allows one of per organisation. Paid plans need a billing plan and a payment card.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Wait for the playground to reach `ready` after a create or resize. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the playground's cluster.
- `expires_at` (String) When the platform tears the playground down unless it is used.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the playground's cluster (mirrors `cluster_id`).
- `ordered_at` (String) When a paid size was ordered; null for the free trial.
- `phase` (String) Provisioning phase the platform reports, refreshed on every read (`ready` once it serves).
- `starter_url` (String) URL of the seeded starter app of a ready free playground; null otherwise.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Playgrounds are imported by their cluster id.
terraform import ankra_playground.example ef8cf93e-1d97-4494-9de4-12ced709ffde
```
